scores.label: Tool proficiency
scores.definition: Commands and skills proven by output, and skills proved on a second task, weighted.
scores.caveat: Reads browser checks and receipts of stamps, not proof of the machine; the per-tool table names each command.

scores.label: Troubleshooting success
scores.definition: Faults resolved, retries that verified, stuck flags cleared and steps resolved within the hour, weighted.
scores.caveat: Faults are team rows; the minutes are a median between two recorded stamps, so a step left open overnight is counted apart.

scores.label: Judgment
scores.definition: Decisions recorded, justified and approved, and changes with a rollback written, equally weighted.
scores.caveat: Counts what was written against named options; it does not judge whether the choice was right.

scores.label: Collaboration
scores.definition: Hand-offs closed, RACI respected and peer reviews given, weighted.
scores.caveat: Team facts count for the team; the role share on the KPIs says what this member moved.

scores.label: Reliability
scores.definition: On time against the cohort calendar, document control complete, controls cited and instructor approval, weighted.
scores.caveat: On time needs the cohort start date; without one the score stands on the other three and says so.

scores.label: Readiness
scores.definition: Exam weight verified, work-role coverage, skills retained and steps in order, weighted.
scores.caveat: A reading of the record against an exam and a work role, not a prediction of a pass or a hire.
